name: climb
summary: Climb nights: on a schedule, an agent improves one number (the test suite's time, first) under a shared protocol; a script makes every measurement and keep-or-revert, and a person merges the one PR.

secrets.name: CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN
secrets.why: Claude's credential (`claude setup-token`), as the claude practice's; each climb night spends model tokens up to .keel/keel.json climb.budget.minutes. Either this or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY; until one is set the run ends green with a notice

secrets.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
secrets.why: the alternative to CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN, billed per token to the API account; set one of the two, not both
